summary.zh-CN: 把已审批的用户反馈交给任意本地处理器，并把结果写回原反馈。
summary.en-US: Hand approved user feedback to any local handler and write the result back to the original report.

title.zh-CN: 一个命令启动后台维护
title.en-US: Start background maintenance with one command

body.zh-CN: 监听已审批反馈，执行任意配置命令，并提供启动、状态、停止和重启生命周期；空闲扫描不调用模型。
body.en-US: Watch approved feedback, run any configured command, and manage start, status, stop, and restart without model calls while idle.

title.zh-CN: 可选的 Codex Desktop 预设

body.zh-CN: 首次反馈创建可见任务，用户补充时续接同一任务；其它 AI、脚本或通知系统可通过普通命令接入。
body.en-US: Create a visible task for the first event and resume it for user follow-ups, while other AI tools, scripts, or notification systems connect through a regular command.

title.en-US: Results return to the original report

body.zh-CN: 维护处理器通过 NextClaw CLI 领取反馈、评论并提交结果；审批、身份和自回复过滤仍由平台约束。
body.en-US: The handler uses the NextClaw CLI to claim feedback, comment, and report results while the platform continues to enforce approval, identity, and self-reply filtering.
